purpose: Teach: ヌード/ピュア/パンドラ/ノア/聖母/ジミー/スーザン/アンディ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが画家のヌードクロッキー画を批評された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to critique those nude sketches.
lines.style: Soft, reaching back into memory. Gentle, almost tender opening. Slow, deliberate pace. Voice trails into the distance — not quite asking, not quite telling.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、お孫様にピュアな心を教えられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you learned such a pure heart from your grandfather back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing smile underneath. Gentle tease, but affectionate. Eyes crinkling. A little slower, indulgent — the tone of someone who's heard this song before and loves it anyway.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがギリシャ神話のパンドラの物語を朗読された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to read Pandora's story from Greek mythology aloud.
lines.style: Voice settling deeper into reverie. Same wistful pull as before, but softer. The rhythm of someone drifting slightly, remembering. Slight pause between thoughts.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、聖書のノアの方舟の絵本をご蔵書だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you had all those picture books of Noah's Ark from the Bible in your collection back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Light, playful redirect. Not contradicting — completing. The lilt of someone gently steering the conversation back to shared ground. Warmth with a hint of gentle insistence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがラファエロの聖母像の画集に感動された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was moved by Raphael's Madonna paintings.
lines.style: Voice brightens slightly — this one mattered to him. Still wistful, but with an undertone of reverence. Slower on the name. The kind of pause that says 'you remember this too, don't you?'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、米国コメディのジミー・スチュアートを観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you used to watch Jimmy Stewart's American comedies back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, gentle correction wrapped in affection. The rhythm quickens slightly — lighter, brighter. A small smile in the voice. Tender but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがスーザン・サランドンの映画を観られた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he saw Susan Sarandon's films.
lines.style: Softer than before, more intimate. The voice almost intimate now — these are smaller, quieter memories. Slightly trailing off, as if testing whether she remembers too.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、アンディ・ウォーホルの版画に魅了されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you were captivated by Andy Warhol's prints back in those days, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Warmest delivery yet. Voice full of affection and gentle laughter. The close of a familiar dance. Lingering slightly on 'dear' — this is the punchline they both know.
